description: AM35 button inventory read (FunctionArea.get_key in disassembly/AM35model.dis line 1666). For each button 1-7, sends '05 5A 03 00 C3 30 {button:02X}'. Response validation: len >= 12, keyType must be 1-13 (reject 0, >=14, 255). When resId != keyType, additional data is parsed based on keyType: 6=标准键 (cKeyCodeRaw[12:14], stdKeyCode[14], comboKeyCode[15]), 8=宏 (macroNameRaw[12:28] as ASCII rstrip \x00, repeatMode[28], repeatTimes[29]), 11=DPI切换+ (dpiAction[12], targetDpiSetting[13:15] le-u16). Single-key failure does not clear the table (onFailure: continue in workflow). Source: disassembly/AM35model.dis get_key (line 1666), request format '05 5A 03 00 C3 30 ' + format(idx, '02X').

samples.comment: Standard key (keyType=6): cKeyCodeRaw=[0x04,0x00], stdKeyCode=0x10, comboKeyCode=0. macroName overlaps cKeyCodeRaw at offset 12; ascii-extract yields control chars (EOT NUL DLE) after rstrip trailing NULs.
Macro (keyType=8): macroNameRaw='Fire'+12 NULs, ascii-extract rstrip NUL -> 'Fire'. repeatMode=1, repeatTimes=3. Primary test for ascii-extract trailing-null removal.
DPI switch+ (keyType=0x0B=11): dpiAction=1, targetDpiSetting=1600 (le-u16 [0x40,0x06]=64+1536). Overlapping fields: cKeyCodeRaw=[1,64], stdKeyCode=6.
Simple type (keyType=1=左键, resId==keyType): no additional data. All data bytes zero; macroName empty after rstrip NUL.

Short response (length=8 < 12): parser cannot read offset 10. Tests partial read / ReadStatus. Workflow continues via onFailure: continue; button5 output marked failed but other buttons remain intact.
